$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Developer Tools row: Inspect Element and the Web Inspector or Chromium DevTools for cmux's own pages. gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptor and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: developerTools
lists.note: Settings > Advanced > Developer Tools (Lawrence 2026-11-07: "make it possible to open chrome devtools in chat ui itself").

rows.note: On (the default, in every build): the agent chat, Home, Markdown and Settings pages offer Inspect Element in their right-click menu, and Toggle Developer Tools (Cmd-Opt-I), Inspect Element (Cmd-Opt-C) and the palette's Developer Tools commands act on them. Off: only browser tabs open developer tools. Browser tabs are never affected.

help.text: Inspect Element in the right-click menu and Toggle Developer Tools (⌥⌘I) work in agent chats, Home, Markdown and Settings. Browser tabs always have them.
